name: hk.common-room/booking
title: Common Room Booking Platform
description: Find Hong Kong venues: hourly hotels, party rooms, event venues, private dining rooms and boats.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Search verified Common Room venues in Hong Kong by type, with optional district, date, number of people and budget. Types offered: hourly_hotel = Hourly hotels / 時鐘酒店; party_room = Party Rooms in Hong Kong / Party Room 香港; event_venue = Event Venue Hong Kong / 場地租用 (商業) 香港; restaurant_private_room = Private Room Restaurant Hong Kong / 包房餐廳 / 餐廳包場; junk_boat = Boat Party / Junk Hong Kong / 船p / 遊船河 租船; serviced_apartment = Serviced Apartment in Hong Kong  / Service Apartment Hong Kong (服務式住宅香港) 月租/短租. For serviced_apartment it returns only the category page link; do not recommend apartments.

district.description: Hong Kong district in English or Chinese, such as "Mong Kok" or "旺角".

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD (Hong Kong time). For hourly hotels, only hotels with open times that day are returned.

budget.description: Maximum starting price in HKD, as shown on the listing.

tools.name: get_venue_details
tools.description: Full public details of one verified venue: description, capacity, prices, facilities, extras, address and booking page link.

venue_id.description: A venue_id from search_venues, such as "venue:my-party-room" or "hotel:my-hotel".

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Open start times and prices for an hourly hotel on a date within the next 13 days, grouped by length of stay (2, 3, 6 hours or overnight). For other venues it returns the booking page, which shows open times.

venue_id.description: A venue_id from search_venues, such as "venue:my-party-room" or "hotel:my-hotel".
